inputsClass.rawdescription:
A boolean input property that trigger the browser native full-screen mode.
The default value is `false`. To trigger the full-screen mode, set the property to `true`.
Setting it back to `false` will not exit the full-screen mode,
you have to manually set it to `false` when the `closeViewer` event is emitted

Setting it back to false will not exit the full-screen mode, you have to manually set it to false when the closeViewer event is emitted

inputsClass.name: showRightSidebar

outputsClass.name: closeViewer
outputsClass.rawdescription: Event emitter that notifies when the document has been closed.
outputsClass.description: Event emitter that notifies when the document has been closed.

components.description:
Component that display the content of a Document.

To use the HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent, you need first to import the component in your module

import { HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent } from '@alfresco/adf-hx-content-services/ui';
@NgModule({
    imports: [
        HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent,
        ...
    ],
   [...]
})
export class AppModule {}

Then use it in your Angular template as shown in the example below:

 <hxp-ui-document-viewer
     [document]="document"
     [showRightSidebar]="showRightSidebar"
     [fullScreen]="fullScreen"
     (closeViewer)="onClose()">
         <ng-template #toolbar>
             <div>Your optional custom toolbar</div>
         </ng-template>
         <ng-template #sidebar>
             <div>Your optional custom sidebar</div>
         </ng-template>
 </hxp-ui-document-viewer>
components.rawdescription:
Component that display the content of a Document. To use the `HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent`, you need first to import the component in your module ```ts import { HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent } from '@alfresco/adf-hx-content-services/ui'; @NgModule({ imports: [ HxpUiDocumentViewerComponent, ... ], [...] }) export class AppModule {} ``` Then use it in your Angular template as shown in the example below: ```html
Your optional custom toolbar
Your optional custom sidebar
 ```
components.templateData:
<adf-viewer
    id="hxp-viewer"
    #viewer
    *ngIf="document"
    [allowFullScreen]="true"
    [allowRightSidebar]="!!sidebarTemplateRef"
    [showViewer]="true"
    [overlayMode]="true"
    [blobFile]="(blobFile$ | async)!"
    (showViewerChange)="onClose()"
>
    <adf-viewer-toolbar class="hxp-document-viewer-toolbar">
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="toolbarTemplateRef || toolbar"></ng-container>
    </adf-viewer-toolbar>
    <adf-viewer-sidebar *ngIf="sidebarTemplateRef">
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="sidebarTemplateRef"></ng-container>
    </adf-viewer-sidebar>
</adf-viewer>
<ng-template #toolbar></ng-template>
